design.name: Subfaction Operational Build & Production Branches
design.principle: No technology unlock tiers. Facilities are operational prerequisites/capacity providers; doctrine and battlefield need choose the branch.

Signature.priorityGate: Major Battle or higher, strategic objective need, or strong surplus; never a mandatory tech unlock

Signature: rare signature formations/assets; still gated by scenario and commitment, not technology

Ultramarines.productionStyle: balanced combined-arms; fill missing battlefield roles before doubling down

Blood Angels.productionStyle: fast assault; maintain enough battleline to hold captured ground

Imperial Fists.productionStyle: siege/defence; establish firing control before expensive armour

Salamanders.productionStyle: durable close-range combined arms; preserve squads and recover damaged assets

Emerald Suns.productionStyle: controlled escalation; defend, regroup, then commit mobile reserves

White Scars.productionStyle: high mobility; prefer transport capacity and redeployment over static defence

Raven Guard.productionStyle: recon/infiltration; reveal targets and create local superiority before committing

Iron Hands.productionStyle: machine-heavy attrition; keep repair/engineering coverage with every armour group

Space Wolves.productionStyle: aggressive hunter packs; vehicles deliver infantry rather than replace them

Black Templars.productionStyle: crusade pressure; prioritize transports and melee mass while retaining objective holders

Cadian 8th.productionStyle: disciplined defence and counterattack; armour supports established infantry lines

Steel Legion.productionStyle: mechanised warfare; do not create infantry waves without enough transport lift

Tempestus Scions.productionStyle: precision deployment; smaller high-quality detachments instead of attrition waves
Tempestus Scions.notes: Add Taurox Prime/Valkyrie production entries when their unit assets exist; current generic Guard vehicle roster cannot express this fully.

Death Korps of Krieg.productionStyle: siege attrition; artillery/engineering branch outranks fast redeployment
Death Korps of Krieg.notes: Add Basilisk/Earthshaker production when available; the current generic Guard roster lacks a true artillery vehicle.

Catachan Jungle Fighters.productionStyle: ambush/recon; avoid overbuilding heavy armour in restrictive terrain

Tallarn Desert Raiders.productionStyle: mobile desert warfare; flank, raid logistics, and preserve movement lanes

Mars Forge.productionStyle: research-led combined arms; machine production scales after power/logistics stability

Ryza Forge.productionStyle: aggressive plasma/vehicle production; tolerate higher energy draw for firepower

Lucius Forge.productionStyle: teleportation and machine preservation; replace losses selectively

Graia Forge.productionStyle: unyielding defence; redundant infrastructure and repair coverage before expansion

Stygies VIII Forge.productionStyle: covert reconnaissance; information advantage determines where expensive machines commit

T'au Sept.productionStyle: balanced ranged cadre; marker support and screening before heavy suits

Vior'la Sept.productionStyle: Mont'ka assault; close-range teams need transport and target acquisition

Sa'cea Sept.productionStyle: urban defence; overlapping ranged fields and marker coverage

Bork'an Sept.productionStyle: prototype-heavy warfare; expensive systems require stable power and fabrication

Dal'yth Sept.productionStyle: coalition/logistics; emphasize transport, flexible auxiliaries, and territorial support

Farsight Enclaves.productionStyle: aggressive close-range combined arms; battlesuits get a much higher production weight

Marker Network.productionStyle: sensor/marker control; never overproduce shooters without enough target designation

Guardian Web.productionStyle: layered defence; drones, sensors and ranged anchors dominate the branch

Recon Swarm.productionStyle: recon screen; mobility and information outrank static production

Ironjaw Mob.productionStyle: brutal assault; infantry mass first, then walkers and heavy wagons

Speed Freeks.productionStyle: speed-first; every large mob should have mobility before another static structure
Speed Freeks.notes: Add Warbike/Deffkilla-style entries later; current Ork vehicle roster only partially expresses a true Speed Freeks army.

Freebooter Fleet.productionStyle: loot-driven combined arms; salvage availability can temporarily override normal production priority

Goff Mob.productionStyle: maximum melee pressure; transports exist to deliver mobs into combat

Bad Moon Mob.productionStyle: dakka economy; ranged weapons and expensive machinery get first claim on surplus scrap

Deathskull Mob.productionStyle: salvage opportunists; counter-build from enemy wrecks and captured equipment

Sautekh.productionStyle: disciplined phalanx; build ranged mass and reanimation depth before decisive assets

Mephrit.productionStyle: annihilation firepower; prioritize ranged killing power and targeting

Novokh.productionStyle: melee execution; teleport/transport delivery supports assault phalanxes

Nihilakh.productionStyle: territorial defence; reanimation and static control outrank pursuit

Nephrekh.productionStyle: translocation mobility; seek weak points instead of building a slow front

Szarekhan.productionStyle: elite dynastic combined arms; preserve high-value units and relic assets

Tomb Watch.productionStyle: automated perimeter defence; sensor coverage and durable garrisons

Repair Cohort.productionStyle: reconstruction force; damaged/reanimating assets suppress unnecessary new production

Hunter Matrix.productionStyle: pursuit/hunter-killer; produce sensors and mobile killers, not static mass

Leviathan.productionStyle: balanced adaptive swarm; maintain synapse and biomass throughput

Kraken.productionStyle: rapid migration; fast broods probe and envelop before monsters commit

Behemoth.productionStyle: shock assault; monstrous creatures open fortified fronts for swarms

Jormungandr.productionStyle: subterranean pressure; tunnel delivery and ambush precede surface mass

Kronos.productionStyle: ranged/anti-warp swarm; bio-artillery stays screened by cheap organisms

Gorgon.productionStyle: adaptive toxins; counter-produce bioforms based on observed enemy physiology/armour

Hydra.productionStyle: endless swarm; brood throughput outranks monster saturation until biomass surplus exists

Lictor Brood.productionStyle: assassination/vanguard; keep monster production sparse unless the target requires it
Lictor Brood.notes: Add Lictor/Deathleaper entries when assets exist; the current generic Tyranid roster does not expose them.

Spore Web.productionStyle: area denial; saturation and bio-artillery protect digestion/reclamation zones

Genestealer Vanguard.productionStyle: infiltration assault; spawn light, fast broods until a breach is created

Black Legion.productionStyle: speartip combined arms; create one hard striking package rather than uniform waves

Word Bearers.productionStyle: ritual/summoning mass; cheap bodies secure sites while daemonic power accumulates

Iron Warriors.productionStyle: siege engineering; heavy firepower and fortified logistics before breakthrough

Night Lords.productionStyle: terror and isolation; hunt weak detachments and avoid fair frontal fights

Alpha Legion.productionStyle: deception/sabotage; information and infiltration can override raw army-size deficits

Emperor's Children.productionStyle: precision/excess; elite quality and target hunting over mass

World Eaters.productionStyle: maximum melee tempo; transport availability is a prerequisite for creating another assault wave
World Eaters.notes: Add Khorne Berzerker/Jakhals entries when assets exist; current generic Chaos roster cannot fully express World Eaters.

Death Guard.productionStyle: slow attrition; production favors durable occupation forces and repair/regeneration

Thousand Sons.productionStyle: sorcery/ranged control; doctrine and intel precede mass production
Thousand Sons.notes: Add Rubric Marine/Sorcerer-specific entries when assets exist; generic Chaos units are only a fallback.

Khorne Host.productionStyle: daemonic melee flood; minimal static investment unless holding a ritual/strategic point

Tzeentch Coven.productionStyle: change/deception; produce counters to enemy composition rather than fixed ratios

Nurgle Host.productionStyle: area denial and attrition; grow forward strongpoints around contested objectives

Slaanesh Host.productionStyle: speed/isolation; repeatedly create local numerical superiority instead of a static line
